annotations.title: MOT pass rate and common failures for a car model

description: First-time MOT pass rate, most common failure areas and specific failures, average mileage at test and results by year of registration for a UK car model (for example make "Ford", model "Fiesta"), calculated from DVSA anonymised MOT test data under the Open Government Licence v3.0. The figures describe groups of cars, not any individual vehicle. If the model has no statistics yet, the models that do are listed.
name: mot_statistics
title: MOT pass rate and common failures for a car model
